remarks:
Located in the heart of the Main Street business district in the village of Akron this building is in very good condition needing only your personal touches. The commercial area has large picture widows for easy displaying of your business goods. The store front is bright with high ceilings, has lots of wall and counter space which could accommodate many different business ventures. There is a large back room with sinks and shelves for storage, working space, or food preparation. The commercial area has a nicely done handicap bathroom. 
The upstairs apartment has a very large living room that is open to the newly remolded kitchen area. It currently has a super large bedroom with dual sliding doors leading to a newer deck overlooking the creek. Possibilities for a second bedroom if desired. There is a separate laundry room with a large closet area. If you're looking for a building to open a new business or move your current business to you'll want to see this one. If you're looking to settle in the village but haven't found that "right one" you might want to look at this opportunity. For less than most one family village residences you can own a super commercial property with really nice living quarters, and rent the commercial area out to help pay your mortgage. This is also listed under residential listing B1718051
There is an open house on Saturday from 11AM to 1PM.
